|lore=Native of Chandrila. Leader of the Alliance. A former member of the Imperial Senate where she was a formidable opponent to then-Senator Palpatine. Friend of Bail Organa.
|game_text=While at your war room, subtracts 1 from each opponent's battle destiny at all system locations and adds 2 to forfeit of all non-unique Rebels. During your deploy phase, may deploy one non-unique Rebel from Reserve Deck and reshuffle.

|notes=This white-border card was first released in the [[Second Anthology]] box (July 1998), as one of its six preview cards; it is the first printing of the card. Endor itself, with the black-border [[Mon Mothma]], followed in June 1999.<ref name="enc27">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=27 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia Rev. 3.2], page 27. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc49">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=49 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia Rev. 3.2], page 49. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Although it previewed Endor, it is a Second Anthology card, so this wiki titles it by that product rather than "Preview". Its last game-text sentence reads "During your deploy phase, may deploy one non-unique Rebel from Reserve Deck and reshuffle." (Endor: "Once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one non-unique Rebel from Reserve Deck; reshuffle."), and its lore reads "opponent to then-Senator Palpatine".
